zh: 有了这封委托书，胡雪岩要好好的动脑筋了。他不断跟古应春有书信往来，上海方面的生意，是托古应春代为接头，尤五的一切情形，也是由古应春代达。所以庞二这面谈成功，他第一件事，就是写信告诉古应春，然后料理杭州这方面所经手的事务，预备在十二月初动身到上海，尽月半以前把丝卖出去，好应付公私帐目。然后开了年，另外再推出新的计划，大干一番。不多几天，古应春的回信来了，让胡雪岩大出意外的是，洋人那方面变了卦，表示年关以前，无意买丝。表面是说，他们国内来信，存货已多，可以暂停。实际上照古应春的了解，外国人也学得门槛精了，知道中国商场的规矩，三节结帐，年下归总，需要大笔头寸。有意想“杀年猪”。如果胡雪岩价钱不是扳得太高，则洋人为了以后的生意，也下会赶尽杀绝。“事情麻烦了！”胡雪岩跟刘不才说，“我自己要头寸在其次，还有许多小户，不能过关，一定会倒过来恳求洋商，虽然他们这点小数，不至于影响整个行情，但中国人的面子是丢掉了！”“那就只有一个办法，”刘不才已经把胡雪岩佩服得五体投地，认为世上没有难得倒他的麻烦，所以语气非常轻松，“你调一笔头寸帮小户的忙，或者买他们的货，或者做押款，叫他们不要上洋人的圈套，不就完了吗？”胡雪岩最初的计议就是如此，难就难在缺头寸，所以听了他的话，唯有报以苦笑。这一下，刘不才也看出意思来了，“老胡，”他说，“我看庞二也是吃软不吃硬的脾气，听见洋人这样可恶，一定不服帖，你何不跟他商量一下看？他的实力雄厚，如果愿意照这个办法做，岂不就过关了？“话是说得不错，但自己有许多公私帐务，一定要有个交代，那又如何说法？这非得细细地通盘筹划一番不可。
en: Now that he had the letter of authorisation, Hu Xueyan needed to think carefully. He had kept up a steady correspondence with Gu Yingchun, who handled his business contacts in Shanghai and passed on all news of You Laowu. Once the agreement with Pang Er was settled, his first act was to write to Gu. Then he attended to the affairs in his charge in Hangzhou, intending to leave for Shanghai early in the twelfth month and sell the silk before mid-month to meet his public and private obligations. After the New Year, he would launch fresh plans and make a great effort. Gu's reply arrived a few days later with an unpleasant surprise: the foreign merchants had changed their minds and had no intention of buying silk before the year ended. They claimed that letters from home reported ample stocks and advised suspending purchases. In Gu's view, however, they had grown shrewd. They knew the Chinese business custom of settling accounts at the three major festivals and making a final reckoning at year-end, when large sums of ready money were needed. They meant to “slaughter the New Year pig.” Yet if Hu did not hold out for too high a price, their interest in future dealings would keep them from driving him entirely to the wall. “This makes things difficult!” Hu told Liu Bucai. “My own need for funds is secondary. Many small dealers won't get through the year. They'll have to turn round and beg the foreigners. Their small quantities won't affect the whole market, but we Chinese will lose face!” Liu now admired him so completely that he thought no difficulty could defeat him. His answer was therefore quite casual. “There's only one solution. Raise some money to help the small dealers: buy their goods or lend against them. Keep them out of the foreigners' trap, and the problem is solved.” That had been Hu's original plan. The difficulty was the lack of money. He could only smile bitterly. Liu understood. “Old Hu, I think Pang Er responds to persuasion but resists pressure. He won't swallow such behaviour from the foreigners. Why not discuss it with him? He has ample resources. If he agrees to your plan, won't that see you through?” True enough. But Hu also had many public and private accounts of his own to settle. What was he to say about those? The whole matter required careful consideration.

zh: 这天晚上，胡雪岩跟刘庆生算了一夜的帐，各处应付款项，能展期的展期，能拖一拖的拖一拖，无论如何要三十万两银子才能过关。而应收及可以调动的款子，不到十五万，头寸还缺一半，更不用说替丝商小户张罗过年的现款。这就到了必须向洋商屈服的时候了。胡雪岩想想实在于心不甘，多少时间心血花在上面，就为的是要弄成“一把抓”的优势，如今有庞二的支持，优势已经出现，但“一把抓”抓不住，仍旧输在洋商手里，这是从何说起？一方面不甘屈服，一方面急景调年，时不我待，胡雪岩彻夜彷徨，想不出善策。急得鬓边见了白发。而刘庆生却又提出警告，该付的不付，面子要弄得很难看了！这个警告的意味，他很了解，万一传出风声，说胡某人的周转不灵，阜康的存户纷纷的提存，这样一“挤兑”，雪上加霜，非倒闭不可。于是他又想到刘不才的话，觉得庞二是个可共患难的人，与其便宜洋商，不如便宜自己人！向庞二去开口，当然是件失面子的事，然而，这是同样的道理，与其丢面子丢给洋人，倒不如丢给自己人。“三爷！你陪我到湖州去一趟。”他这样跟刘不才说，“这一趟去要看我的运气，如果庞二闹家务，已经顺顺利利了结，我说话也就容易了。不然，他自己都弄得‘头盔倒挂’，我怎么还开得出口？”“好的。”刘不才说，“我看我们直接赶到南浔去吧，不必先到湖州，再走回头路就耽误工夫了。“胡雪岩点点头，未置可否，心里在盘算杭州跟上海两方面的交代，细想一想，就是三、五天的工夫也不容易抽出来，年底下的商场，虽不是瞬息万变，却往往会出意外，万一有何变化，自己措手不及，岂不误了大事，刘不才看他踌躇不决，知道他必须坐镇在杭州，因而试探着说：“雪岩，你看是不是我代你去走一趟？”
en: That night Hu and Liu Qingsheng worked over the accounts until morning. They extended whatever payments could be extended and postponed whatever could be postponed, but still needed three hundred thousand taels to get through the year. Receivables and funds that could be mobilised amounted to less than a hundred and fifty thousand. Half the required sum was still missing, even before finding year-end cash for the small silk dealers. He had reached the point of having to submit to the foreign merchants. The thought was intolerable. So much time and effort had gone into securing the advantage of a unified grip on the business. With Pang's support, that advantage was finally taking shape. Yet he could not maintain his grip and would still lose to the foreigners. How could this be? Unwilling to yield, with the year's end fast approaching and time running out, he worried through the night without finding an answer. Anxiety brought grey hairs to his temples. Liu Qingsheng added a warning: failure to pay what was due would look very bad. Hu understood what that meant. If word spread that he was short of working funds, Fukang's depositors would rush to withdraw their money. Such a run would make matters worse and force the bank to close. He thought again of Liu Bucai's suggestion. Pang Er seemed a man with whom one could share adversity. Better to let one of their own profit than the foreigners. Asking him for help would certainly cost face, but the same principle applied: better to lose face before one of their own. “Third Master, come with me to Huzhou,” he said. “This journey will depend on my luck. If Pang's family dispute has been settled smoothly, I can speak more easily. If his own affairs are in a muddle, how can I open my mouth?” “Very well. I think we should go straight to Nanxun. Going to Huzhou first and then doubling back would waste time.” Hu nodded without committing himself. He was considering the arrangements needed in both Hangzhou and Shanghai. On reflection, even three or five days were hard to spare. Business at year-end might not change every instant, but unexpected developments were frequent. If something happened while he was unprepared, it could ruin everything. Seeing his hesitation and understanding that he must remain in charge in Hangzhou, Liu ventured, “Xueyan, why don't I go in your place?”

zh: 这倒是个办法。刘不才的才干，办这样一件事，可以胜任。但他还有一件事不放心，“三爷！”他说，“你去了不能露出急吼吼的样子……”“这何消说得？”刘不才抢着说，“我不能连这一点都不懂。”“不是！我还有话。”胡雪岩说，“既然不是急如星火的事，那就可以从从容容来。大少爷的脾气，你是最明白不过的，”他模拟着庞二的态度说：“ ‘好了，好了，凡事有我。先赌一场再说。’那时候你怎么样？”刘不才想想不错，这一赌下来，说不定就耽误了胡雪岩的工夫，千万赌不得！“我这样跟他说：我自己在杭州还有许多事，要赶回去料理，到年三十，我赶到南浔来，陪你好好赌几场。”“对！就是这么说。”胡雪岩又郑重的加了一句：“三爷，你可不能拆我的烂污！”“你不相信我，就不要叫我去。”说到这话，胡雪岩不能再多提一句，当时写了信，雇了一只船，加班添人，星夜赶到南浔去会庞二，约定无论事成与否，三天以后，必定回来。
en: That offered a solution. Liu had the ability to handle such a mission, but one concern remained. “Third Master, when you arrive, you mustn't look desperate...” “Surely you don't need to tell me that!” Liu interrupted. “I understand that much.” “No, there's more. If it doesn't seem desperately urgent, there will seem to be time to spare. You know that rich young master's temper better than anyone.” Imitating Pang, Hu said, “‘All right, all right. Leave everything to me. Let's have a game first.’ What will you do then?” Liu saw the point. Once they started gambling, he might delay Hu's business. He must not play. “I'll tell him I have a great deal to attend to in Hangzhou and must hurry back. On New Year's Eve I'll come to Nanxun and play as many games as he likes.” “Exactly. Say just that.” Hu added solemnly, “Third Master, you mustn't let me down!” “If you don't trust me, don't send me.” After that, Hu could say no more. He wrote the letter and hired a boat, adding extra hands to speed it on its way through the night to Nanxun. They agreed that, successful or not, Liu must return in three days.

zh: 这三天自是度日如年的光景，但胡雪岩决不会独坐愁城，听天由命，他要作万一的打算，所以依然每天一早，坐镇阜康，不断派出人去联络试探，希望能找出一条得以筹集这笔巨款的路子来。第一天第二天都毫无结果，到了第三天，他就有些沉不住气了，正在攒眉苦思时，嵇鹤龄到阜康钱庄来相访，一见面便讶然说道：“雪岩，几天不见，你何以清瘦如此？”异姓手足，无需掩饰，胡雪岩老实答道：“还差三十万银子，怎么不急得人瘦？”听这话，嵇鹤龄大吃一惊，“你怎不跟我说？那天我问你，你不是说可以‘摆平’吗？”他带些责备语气地问。“跟你说了，害你着急，何苦？”胡雪岩改用宽慰的语气说，“只要海运局的那笔宕帐，你能给我维持住，别的也还不要紧。”怎么又说不要紧？显见得他是故意叫人宽心。嵇鹤龄想了想问道：“你总得想办法罗！”“是的。”他说了遣刘不才到南浔乞援的事，“我给庞二的信上说，我愿意照市价卖多少包丝给他，便宜不落外方。我这样吃亏还卸面子，他应该可以帮我这个忙。”“年底下一下子要调动三十万的头寸，不是件容易的事。”“其实，有一半也可以过关了。”“十五万也不是少数。”嵇鹤龄招招手说，“你来，我跟你句话。”
en: Those three days naturally seemed like years. But Hu would never sit helplessly with his troubles and leave everything to fate. He needed a fallback. Each morning he took his place at Fukang and kept sending people out to make contacts and test possibilities, hoping to find some means of raising the large sum. The first two days produced nothing. On the third he was beginning to lose his composure. While he sat frowning in thought, Ji Heling called at the bank. “Xueyan!” Ji exclaimed. “It's only been a few days since I saw you. How have you grown so thin?” There was no need to conceal anything from a sworn brother. “I'm still three hundred thousand taels short,” Hu said frankly. “How could I help worrying myself thin?” Ji was shocked. “Why didn't you tell me? When I asked the other day, didn't you say you could put everything in order?” There was reproach in his voice. “What good would it do to make you anxious too?” Hu adopted a reassuring tone. “As long as you can keep that outstanding Sea Transport Bureau account from being pressed, the rest isn't too serious.” Not serious? Plainly he was trying to put Ji at ease. After thinking a moment, Ji asked, “But you must be doing something?” “Yes.” Hu explained Liu's mission to Nanxun. “In my letter, I offered to sell Pang a quantity of silk at the current market price, so the benefit would stay among ourselves. Since I'm accepting a loss and swallowing my pride, he ought to help.” “Raising three hundred thousand at once at the year's end is no easy matter.” “Actually, half would see me through.” “A hundred and fifty thousand is no small sum either.” Ji beckoned. “Come here. I have something to tell you.”

zh: 到得僻处密谈，嵇鹤龄告诉他一个消息，是裘丰言谈起的，说有个洋商走了“炮局”龚振麟、龚之棠父子的路子，龚家父子又走了黄抚台三姨太的路子，决定跟洋商买一万五千支洋枪，每支三十二两银子，价款先发六成，就在这两天要立约付款了。听得这个消息，胡雪岩大为诧异，买洋枪是他的创议，如果试用满意，大量购置，当然是他原经手来办，何以中途易手，变成龚家父子居间？当然，这是不用说的，其中必有花佯，胡雪岩问道：“可晓得那洋商叫什么名字？”“不知道。听说是个普鲁士人。”“那就不是哈德逊了。”胡雪岩说，“这笔生意，每支枪起码有十二两的虚头，一万五千支枪是十八万，回扣还不算。这样子办公事，良心未免太黑了一点。”“这不去说它了。我告诉你这个消息，是提醒你想一想，这笔款子，能不能在你手里过一过，能够办得到，岂不是眼前的难关，可以过去？”这倒是个很新鲜的意见。胡雪岩对任何他不曾想到的主意，都有兴趣，于是扳着手指数道：“一万五千乘三十二，总价四十八万银子，先付六成就是二十八万八，弄它一升半就差不多了。”“你跟龚家父子认识不认识？我倒有个朋友，跟小龚很熟，可以为你先容。”“好极了！等我想一想。这条路子一定有用的。”
en: In a secluded spot, Ji passed on news from Qiu Fengyan. A foreign merchant had approached Gong Zhenlin of the Cannon Bureau and his son Gong Zhitang. They in turn had approached Governor Huang's third concubine, and a purchase of fifteen thousand foreign guns had been agreed at thirty-two taels apiece, with sixty per cent paid in advance. The contract was to be signed and the money paid within the next day or two. Hu was astonished. Buying foreign guns had been his own initiative. If the trial proved satisfactory and a large purchase followed, surely he, as the original agent, should handle it. Why had the business changed hands, with the Gongs acting as intermediaries? Obviously there must be some trick behind it. “Do you know the merchant's name?” he asked. “No. I hear he's Prussian.” “Then it isn't Hudson. There's at least twelve taels of padding in the price of each gun. On fifteen thousand guns, that's a hundred and eighty thousand, before counting any commission. Their consciences must be very black to handle public business like this.” “Leave that aside. I'm telling you so that you can consider whether the money might pass through your hands. If that could be arranged, wouldn't it solve your immediate difficulty?” It was a fresh suggestion. Hu always took an interest in an idea that had not occurred to him. Counting on his fingers, he said, “Fifteen thousand times thirty-two makes four hundred and eighty thousand taels. Sixty per cent in advance is two hundred and eighty-eight thousand. If I could get roughly half of that, it would be about enough.” “Do you know the Gongs? A friend of mine knows the younger Gong well and could introduce you.” “Excellent! Let me think. This avenue is bound to be useful.”

zh: 胡雪岩略为一想，就看出了这桩交易之中的不妥之处，一万五千支洋枪，是一批极惹人注目的军火，近则上海的小刀会，远则金陵的太平军，一定都会眼红，如果在上海起运，不管陆路水路，中途都难免会出纰漏。“怎么样能把合同打听出来就好了。”胡雪岩自语似地说，“我看这件事，怕有点靠不住！”“怎么靠不住，千真万确有些事。”“我不是说没有这件事，是说这笔生意，怕要出乱子，龚家父子会惹极大的麻烦。”接着，胡雪岩将他的顾虑，跟嵇鹤龄细谈了一遍。“我懂了！”嵇鹤龄说，“症结在交货的地方，如果是在上海交货，黄抚台得派重兵护运。这倒是很麻烦的事。”“有了！”胡雪岩当时便把刘庆生找了来问说：“抚台衙门刘二爷的节敬送了没有？”“还早啊！”“要提前送了。”胡雪岩说，“我记得是每节一百两，过年二百两，请你另外封四百两，连例规一起送去，说我拜托他务心帮个忙！”要刘二帮忙的，就是把合同的原底子设法抄了来。刘二看在两个红封，总计六百两银票的面上，这个忙非帮不可，又因为龚家父子越过他这一关，以同乡内眷，经常来往的便利，直接搭上了三姨太的线，心里原就有气，这时猜测胡雪岩的用意。大概要动脑筋打消这笔买卖，自所乐见，格外巴结，当天就用五十两银子买通了黄宗汉的娈童兼值签押房的小听差，把合同的底稿偷了出来，刘二关上民门，亲自录了个副本，神不知鬼不觉地送到了胡雪岩手里。
en: A little thought revealed a weakness in the transaction. Fifteen thousand foreign guns were a consignment of arms that would attract enormous attention. The Small Swords Society nearby in Shanghai and the Taiping forces farther away in Jinling would certainly covet them. Whether sent from Shanghai by land or water, they would be vulnerable along the route. “If only we could discover what the contract says,” Hu murmured. “I suspect something isn't sound here.” “Not sound? The information is absolutely certain.” “I don't doubt that the transaction exists. I mean it may go wrong and land the Gongs in serious trouble.” He explained his concerns. “I see,” Ji said. “The crucial point is where delivery takes place. If it's Shanghai, Governor Huang will have to send a strong escort. That would be troublesome.” “I have it!” Hu summoned Liu Qingsheng. “Have we sent Second Master Liu at the governor's yamen his festival gift?” “It's still early.” “Send it ahead of time. I recall it's a hundred taels at each festival and two hundred at New Year. Put another four hundred in a separate envelope and send both. Tell him I have a favour to ask and beg him to take special care.” The favour was to obtain a copy of the original draft contract. For two red envelopes containing banknotes worth six hundred taels, Liu Er could hardly refuse. Besides, he resented the Gongs for bypassing him. As people from the same native place, their womenfolk called frequently on the governor's household, and they had used that advantage to approach the third concubine directly. Liu guessed that Hu meant to find a way to stop the purchase, a prospect he welcomed. He was particularly obliging. That same day, fifty taels bought the cooperation of Huang Zonghan's young male favourite, who also served as a junior attendant in the official signing room. The attendant stole out the draft. Liu shut the door, copied it himself, and delivered the copy to Hu in complete secrecy.

zh: 合同上写的是由船运在浙江边境交货。胡雪岩倒弄不明白。这个名叫鲁道夫的普鲁士人，具何神通？能够安然通过上海到嘉善的这一段水路？倘或中途出险，不能如约交货，又将如何？细看合同，果然有个绝大的漏洞，这笔买卖，在卖主方面自然有保人，由上海的两家钱庄承保，但保的是“交货短少”及“货样不符”，又特为规定一样：“卖方将枪支自外洋运抵上海后，禀请浙江抚台衙门委派委员，即就海关眼同检验，须验得式样数目相符，始得提领交运。”看起来好象公事认真，完全为了维护买方的利益，实际上是正好为卖方脱卸责任。“好刀笔！”在一起细看合约的嵇鹤龄，书生积习，不免愤慨，“公家办事，就是如此！自作聪明，反上了别人的当。”“恐怕不是自作聪明，是故作聪明。”胡雪岩说，“照这个合约来看，卖方只要把洋枪运到上海，在海关经过浙江的委员眼同检验，数量式样相符，卖方就已尽了责任，如果中途遇劫，那就好比当票上的条规：”天灾人祸，与典无涉。‘保人是不保兵险的。真的闹将开来，洋人只要说一句：在你们中国地方被抢的。你们自己不能维持地方平靖，与外人什么相干？这话驳不到，还只能捏着鼻子受他的！“嵇鹤龄也是才气横溢，料事极透的人，听了胡雪岩的话，连连点头，嘴角中现出极深沉诡秘的笑容，眼睛不断眨动，似乎别有深奥的领悟似地。
en: The contract specified delivery by boat at the Zhejiang border. Hu was puzzled. What remarkable powers did this Prussian, Rudolf, possess that would let him pass safely along the waterway from Shanghai to Jiashan? If trouble prevented delivery, what would happen? A closer reading revealed a tremendous loophole. The seller had guarantors, two Shanghai banks, but their guarantee covered only shortages in quantity and discrepancies in specifications. There was also a special clause: “After the seller has transported the guns from overseas to Shanghai, the Zhejiang governor's yamen shall be requested to appoint commissioners to inspect them jointly at the customs house. Only after the specifications and quantities have been verified as conforming may the goods be released for onward shipment.” It looked like careful administration, wholly intended to protect the buyer. In reality, it provided precisely the means for the seller to escape responsibility. “What skilful legal drafting!” Ji, studying the contract beside him, could not suppress a scholar's indignation. “This is how public business is done! They think themselves clever and fall into someone else's trap.” “Perhaps they're pretending to be clever,” Hu replied. “Under this contract, once the guns reach Shanghai and the Zhejiang commissioners have verified their quantity and specifications at customs, the seller has discharged his responsibility. If they're robbed on the way, it's like the rule on a pawn ticket: ‘The pawnbroker is not liable for natural or human disasters.’ The guarantors don't cover war risks. If a dispute arises, the foreigner need only say, ‘They were stolen in your country. If you can't maintain order in your own territory, what has that to do with us?’ We couldn't refute him. We'd have to hold our noses and swallow it.” Ji, himself exceptionally able and perceptive, nodded repeatedly. A deep, cryptic smile appeared at the corners of his mouth. His eyes kept blinking, as though he had reached some further understanding.

zh: “大哥！”胡雪岩问道：“你另有看法？”“我是拿你的话，进一步去想。也许是‘小人之心’，但是，人家未必是君子，所以我的猜测也不见得不对。”说了半天，到底是指什么呢？胡雪岩有些不耐，催促着说：“大哥！你快说吧，这件事上，也许可以生发出什么办法来，如今时间不多了，我们得要快动脑筋，快动手。”于是嵇鹤龄提纲挈领的只问了一句，胡雪岩就懂了，所问这一句是：“这会不会是个骗局？”如果要行骗，根据合约来说，并不是不可能：洋枪运到上海关，浙江所派的委员验明了数目式样，无不相符，但交运中途，说是遇到劫盗，意外灾祸，不负责任。至于是不是真的抢走了洋枪，无可究诘，那就可以造成骗局。倘或事先有勾结，浙江的委员虚应故事，数目既不够，式样也不符，而以“相符”禀报，及至被动，亦是无可究诘，这个骗局就更厉害了。“我看，”胡雪岩毕竟是商人，迟疑着问道：“这，我看他们不至于如此大胆吧？”“哈！”嵇鹤龄冷笑，“你不知官场的龌龊！事实俱在，这合约中有漏洞，人之才智，谁不如我？我们一看就看出来了，他们经过那么多人看，说是不曾看出来，其谁能信？”“是的。”胡雪岩点点头，转问出一句极要紧的话：“既然我们看出来了，该怎么办？”嵇鹤龄笑了，“以你的聪明，何需问我？”他说，“你定策，我看我能不能帮你的忙！”胡雪岩觉得嵇鹤龄这个人不失为君子，在这样异姓手足之亲，时不我待之迫，有了机会还不肯出“坏主意”，就算很难得了。
en: “Elder Brother, have you another thought?” Hu asked. “I'm taking your argument a step further. Perhaps it's a base suspicion, but the others may not be honourable men. My guess needn't be wrong.” What, after all that, did he mean? Hu grew impatient. “Tell me quickly! There may be some way forward in this. Time is short. We must think and act fast.” Ji needed only one question to make his point. “Could it be a fraud?” Under the contract, fraud was certainly possible. The guns would reach Shanghai customs, and Zhejiang's commissioners would report the quantity and specifications correct. During onward shipment, the seller could claim robbery, an unforeseen calamity for which he bore no responsibility. Whether the guns had actually been stolen would be impossible to establish. That opened the way to a swindle. With collusion arranged beforehand, the commissioners might merely go through the motions. Even if the quantity were short and the specifications wrong, they could report conformity. Once the goods were said to have been stolen, investigation would be equally impossible. That would be an even greater fraud. Hu was, after all, a businessman. Hesitantly he said, “Surely they wouldn't dare go that far?” “Ha!” Ji sneered. “You don't know how filthy official life is! Here are the facts: there's a loophole in the contract. Why should everyone else be less intelligent than we are? We saw it at a glance. So many people have examined it. Who could believe none of them noticed?” “Yes.” Hu nodded, then asked the essential question. “Now that we've seen it, what should we do?” Ji smiled. “With your intelligence, why ask me? Decide on a plan, and I'll see how I can help.” Hu thought Ji remained a gentleman. Even with the closeness of sworn brotherhood between them and time pressing so urgently, he would not suggest an underhanded scheme when the opportunity arose. That was rare indeed.

zh: “办法当然很多。”胡雪岩想了想说，“光棍不断财路，只要他们不是行骗，生意仍旧让他们去做。不过，我觉得黄抚台不作兴这样，我也帮过他好些忙，买洋枪又是我开的路子，现在叫别人去做这笔生意，想想于心不甘。”嵇鹤龄听他的话一脚进、一脚出，便知道他的意思了，反正只要能对他眼前的难关有帮助，他也不愿多事，照此宗旨替他设想，觉得有跟龚家父子开个谈判的必要。“请谁去谈判呢？”胡雪岩问，“托你的朋友？”“不！这件事你我先都还不便出面，叫裘丰言去！”“妙！妙！”胡雪岩抚掌称善，“我们马上找他来谈。”于是就借嵇鹤龄的地方，由瑞云设炉置酒，叫人去请裘丰言。时已深夜，天气已冷，裘丰言黄昏时分喝得醺醺然，早已上了床，但听说嵇、胡二人请他围炉消夜，立刻披衣起床，冒着凛冽的西北风，兴冲冲地赶到嵇家。一进门他就把“寒夜客来茶当酒”这句诗改了一下，朗然而吟：“寒夜客来酒当茶！”不但嵇鹤龄和胡雪岩相视莞尔，连隔室的瑞云都笑了，只见小丫头把门帘一掀，她一手提个酒瓶，一手提把酒壶，扬一扬笑道：“裘老爷，有的是酒，中国酒、外国酒都有，你尽管喝！”
en: “There are plenty of ways,” Hu said after a little thought. “A man of the world doesn't cut off another's livelihood. If they aren't committing fraud, let them keep the business. Still, Governor Huang shouldn't treat me this way. I've helped him often enough, and I opened the way to buying foreign guns. To see someone else given the transaction now—it's hard to accept.” Ji understood the way Hu's words advanced and retreated. So long as the matter helped him through his immediate difficulty, he did not want further trouble. On that basis, Ji thought they ought to negotiate with the Gongs. “Who should negotiate?” Hu asked. “Your friend?” “No. Neither of us should appear at this stage. Send Qiu Fengyan.” “Excellent!” Hu clapped his hands. “Let's get him here at once.” They used Ji's house, where Ruiyun set out a brazier and wine, and sent for Qiu. It was late and cold. Having drunk himself pleasantly tipsy at dusk, Qiu had long since gone to bed. But the invitation to a late supper round the brazier brought him up at once. He dressed and hurried eagerly to Ji's through the bitter north-westerly wind. On entering, he altered the poetic line “On a cold night, a guest arrives; tea takes the place of wine,” and declaimed, “On a cold night, a guest arrives; wine takes the place of tea!” Ji and Hu exchanged smiles. Even Ruiyun in the next room laughed. A little maid lifted the door curtain, and Ruiyun appeared with a bottle in one hand and a wine pot in the other. Raising them, she said, “Mr Qiu, there's plenty! Chinese wine and foreign wine—drink all you please!”

zh: “多谢如嫂夫人！”裘丰言兜头一揖，然后接过一瓶白兰地，拔开寒头，先就嘴对嘴喝了一口。这一下惹得瑞云又笑，“裘老爷喝酒倒省事，”她说，“用不着备菜！”“这话在别处可以这么说，在府上我就不肯这么说了。”“为什么呢？”“说了是我的损失。说句不怕人见笑的话，我这几天想吃府上的响螺跟红糟鸡，想得流涎不止。”“那真正是裘老爷的口福，今天正好有这两样东西。”瑞云笑道，“不过，不好意思拿出来待客，因为吃残了！”“怕什么，怕什么！来到府上，我就象回到舍下，没有说嫌自己家里的东西吃残的。”于是瑞云将现成的菜，办了一个火锅、四只碟子为他们主客三人消夜，嵇鹤龄一面劝酒，一面为裘丰言谈那张购枪合同的毛病。他虽未提到胡雪岩，而有了几分酒意，并且一向与胡雪岩交好的裘丰言却很替他不平。“是可忍，孰不可忍！这件事非得好好评理不可。”
en: “My thanks, Madam!” Qiu bowed deeply, took a bottle of brandy, pulled out the stopper, and drank straight from its mouth. Ruiyun laughed again. “Mr Qiu makes drinking so easy. There's no need to prepare food!” “You might say that elsewhere, but I won't let you say it here.” “Why not?” “Because I'd lose by it. At the risk of being laughed at, I've spent the last few days positively drooling over the thought of your sea conch and chicken in red wine lees.” “Then you are fortunate. We happen to have both today.” She smiled. “Only I'm ashamed to serve them to guests. They've already been eaten from.” “What does that matter? Coming here is like coming home. Nobody objects to leftovers in his own house.” Using what was ready, Ruiyun prepared a hotpot and four small dishes for the three men's supper. As Ji urged Qiu to drink, he explained the faults in the gun contract. Though he said nothing of Hu, Qiu, already a little tipsy and always friendly towards him, felt indignant on his behalf. “If this can be tolerated, what cannot? We must have the rights and wrongs of this properly argued!”

zh: “少安毋躁！”嵇鹤龄拉着他的手说，“今天请你来就是要跟你商量个打抱不平的办法。毛病捉住了，但‘没有金刚钻，不揽碎瓷器’，龚家父子也不是好相与的人，这件事还得平心静气来谈。”“好，好！”裘丰言喝口酒，夹块红糟鸡放在口中咀嚼着，含含糊糊他说，“有你们两位在，没有我的主意，你们商量，我喝着酒听。”嵇胡两人对看一眼，都觉得老实人也不易对付，他们原先有过约定，预备一搭一档，旁敲侧击，让裘丰言自告奋勇，现在他是“唯君所命”的态度，说话就不能再绕圈子，否则便显得不够朋友，所以反觉得为难。当然，还是得嵇鹤龄开口，他想了一下看着胡雪岩说：“做倒有个做法，比较厉害，不过盘马弯弓，不能收立竿见影之效。”“不管它！你先说你的。”“我想，老裘办过一回提运洋枪的差使，也可以说是内行，不妨上他一个说帖，就说有英商接头，愿意卖枪给浙江，条件完全跟他们一佯，就是价钱便宜，每支只要二十五两银子。看他们怎么说？”“此计大妙！”说不开口的裘丰言，到底忍不住开口，“有此说帖，黄抚台就不能包庇了，不然言官参上一本，朝廷派大员密查，我来出头，看他如何搪塞？”“不至于到此地步。这个说帖一上，龚家父子一定会来找你说话，那时就有得谈了。”嵇鹤龄转眼看着胡雪岩说，“有好处也在年后。”裘丰言不明用意，接口又说：“年后就年后，反正不多几天就过年了。”嵇鹤龄听得这话，慢慢抬眼看着胡雪岩，是征询及催促的眼色，意思是让他对裘丰言有所表白。胡雪岩会意，但不想说破真意，因为这对袭丰言无用，此人样样都好，就是办到正事，头绪不能太多，跟他说了他也许反嫌麻烦，答一句：“长话短说，我记不住那么多！”岂不是自己找钉子碰？因此，胡雪岩只这样说，“不管什么时候收效，这件事对老裘有益无害，我看先上了说帖再作道理。”“那也好。”嵇鹤龄转脸问道：“老裘，你看怎么样？”
en: “Calm yourself.” Ji took his hand. “We invited you precisely to discuss how to put this injustice right. We've found the weakness, but you don't undertake to mend porcelain without a diamond drill. The Gongs aren't easy men to deal with. We must discuss it calmly.” “Very well!” Qiu drank, put a piece of chicken in his mouth, and said indistinctly as he chewed, “With you two here, I've no opinion to offer. You discuss it. I'll drink and listen.” Ji and Hu exchanged a glance. Even an honest fellow could be hard to manage. They had planned to play off one another, approaching the matter indirectly until Qiu volunteered. Now that he was placing himself entirely at their disposal, further circumlocution would be unfriendly. It left them in an awkward position. Naturally Ji had to speak. After a moment's thought, he looked at Hu. “There is one rather forceful approach. But it's a matter of drawing the bow and holding the threat. It won't produce an immediate result.” “Never mind. Tell us.” “Qiu has already handled the collection and transport of foreign guns, so he can claim experience. He might submit a memorandum saying that a British merchant has approached him and is willing to sell guns to Zhejiang on exactly the same terms, but at only twenty-five taels apiece. Let's see what they say.” “An excellent plan!” Qiu, despite his promise of silence, could not contain himself. “With that memorandum before him, Governor Huang couldn't shield them. Otherwise a censor might impeach him and the court send a high official to investigate secretly. I'd come forward then and see how he explained himself!” “It won't go that far. Once the memorandum is submitted, the Gongs are certain to approach you. Then there'll be something to discuss.” Ji turned to Hu. “Any benefit will come after the New Year.” Not understanding the purpose, Qiu said, “After the New Year, then! It's only a few days away.” Ji slowly raised his eyes to Hu, questioning and prompting him to make some explanation. Hu understood but did not want to reveal his real purpose. It would do no good with Qiu. An excellent fellow in other ways, he could not manage too many threads in serious business. If told, he might only find it troublesome and say, “Make it short! I can't remember all that.” Why invite a rebuff? Hu therefore said only, “Whenever it produces results, this can only benefit Qiu. Let's submit it first and see.” “Very well.” Ji turned back. “What do you think?”

zh: “除却酒杯莫问我！”醉眼迷离的裘丰言，答了这样一句诗样的话，一只手又去抓酒瓶。“你不能喝了！”嵇鹤龄夺住他的手，“要办正事就不能喝醉。等办完了事，我让你带一瓶回去。”裘丰言恋恋不舍的松了手，瑞云在隔室很见机，立刻进来收拾残肴剩酒，另外端来一锅“烧鸭壳子”熬的粥，四样吃粥小菜。裘丰言就着象牙色的“冬腌菜”，连吃三碗，“好舒服！”他摸着肚子说：“酒醉饭饱，该办正事了。是不是拟说帖？““对了！”嵇鹤龄问道：“你还能动笔不能？”“有何不能，‘太白斗酒诗百篇’，何况平铺直叙一说帖？”“那好！你先喝着茶，抽两袋烟休息。我跟雪岩商量一下。”于是两个人移坐窗前，悄悄的商议，因为有些话不便当着裘丰言说，首先就要考虑他个人的利害。
en: “Ask me nothing beyond the wine cup!” Qiu answered in something like a line of verse, his drunken eyes misty as he reached again for the bottle. “No more!” Ji caught his hand. “You mustn't get drunk when there's work to do. Once it's finished, I'll give you a bottle to take home.” Reluctantly Qiu let go. Ruiyun, alert to the situation from the next room, promptly cleared away the remaining food and wine. She brought a pot of rice gruel simmered with a roast-duck carcass and four accompaniments. With ivory-coloured winter-pickled vegetables, Qiu ate three bowls. “How comfortable!” he said, rubbing his stomach. “Full of wine and food—now for business. Are we drafting the memorandum?” “Exactly. Can you still wield a brush?” “Why not? ‘A measure of wine, a hundred poems from Li Bai.’ Surely I can manage one plain memorandum!” “Good. Have some tea, smoke a couple of pipes, and rest while Xueyan and I discuss it.” They moved to the window and spoke quietly. Some things could not be said before Qiu. First they must consider the consequences for him personally.

zh: “这个说帖一上，黄抚台自然把裘丰言恨得牙痒，将来或许会有吃亏的时候，我们做朋友的，不能不替他想到。”“这当然要顾虑。不过，大哥，我跟你的看法有点西洋，黄抚台这个人，向来敬酒不吃吃罚酒，说不定这一来反倒对老裘另眼相看。”嵇鹤龄想了想说：“这一层暂且不管，只是这个说帖，要弄得象真的一样才好。”“本来就要有这个打算。真的这笔生意能够拿过来，二十五两银子一支一定可以买得到，而且包定有钱赚。”等这一点弄明白了，说帖便不难拟，移砚向灯，他们两个人斟酌着一条一条地说，裘丰言便一条一条地写。写完再从头斟酌，作成定稿，说好由裘丰言找人去分缮三份，一份送抚台，一份送藩台。这件事明天上午就得去妥。“好！这都归我。现在问下一步，说帖送了上去，黄抚台要找我，我该怎么说？”“黄抚台不会找你！”嵇鹤龄极有把握地答道：“要找一定是龚家父子来找你。”“那总也要有话说啊！”“这不忙！他来找你，你来找我。”“等我来找你，你的‘过年东道’就有着落了。”胡雪岩觉得这话不妥，因而紧接着笑道，“这是我说笑话，不管怎么样，你今年过年不必发愁，一切有我！”“多谢，多谢！”裘丰言满脸是笑，“说实话，交上你们两位朋友，我本来就不用愁。”说到这里，裘丰言站起身来告辞，胡雪岩亦不再留，一起离了槛家，约定第二天晚饭时分，不管消息如何，仍在嵇家碰头。
en: “Once the memorandum goes in, Governor Huang will hate Qiu. He may suffer for it later. As his friends, we must consider that.” “Of course. But, Elder Brother, I see it a little differently. Governor Huang has always responded to pressure better than courtesy. This might even make him regard Qiu with new respect.” Ji reflected. “Leave that aside for now. The memorandum must at least look genuine.” “We must be prepared to make it genuine. If we actually take over the transaction, we can certainly supply guns at twenty-five taels each and still make a profit.” Once that was clear, drafting was easy. They moved the inkstone towards the lamp. Ji and Hu considered each point and dictated it, and Qiu wrote each one down. Then they reviewed the whole and settled on a final text. Qiu would have three fair copies made, one for the governor and one for the provincial treasurer. This must be done the next morning. “Very well. Leave all that to me. Now, the next step: once it's submitted, what should I say if Governor Huang sends for me?” “He won't,” Ji replied with complete confidence. “It will be the Gongs who come.” “I still need something to say.” “There's no hurry. When they come to you, come to me.” “By the time I come to you, your New Year expenses will be provided for,” Hu added. Feeling this was ill-judged, he immediately laughed. “I'm joking. Whatever happens, don't worry about this New Year. Leave everything to me!” “Thank you, thank you!” Qiu beamed. “To tell the truth, with friends like you two, I had no need to worry anyway.” He rose to leave. Hu did not detain him and left Ji's house with him. They agreed to meet there again at supper the following evening, whether there was news or not.

zh: 裘丰言感于知遇，特别实力，回家以后，就不再睡，好在洋酒容易发散，洗过一把脸，喝过两杯浓茶，神思便已清醒，于是挑灯磨墨，决定把这通说帖抄好了它，一早“上院”去递。这一番折腾，把他的胖太太吵得不能安眠，“死鬼！她在帐子里”娇嗔“：”半夜三更，又是这么冷的天气，不死到床上来，在搞啥鬼！“你睡你的，我有公事。”这真是新闻了，裘丰言一天到晚无事忙，从未动笔办过公。事，而况又是如此深宵，说有公事，岂非奇谈！“你骗鬼！什么公事？一定又是搞什么‘花样’，穷开心！”胖太太又说，“快过年了，也不动动脑筋，看你年三十怎么过？”“就是为了年三十好过关，不能不拼老命。你少跟我罗嗦，我早早弄完了，还要上院。”听说上院，就决不是搞什么“花样”，胖太太一则有些不信，二则也舍不得“老伴”一个人“拼老命”，于是从床上起身，走来一看，白折子封面写着“说帖”二字，这才相信他真的是在忙公事。“你去睡嘛！”裘丰言搓一搓手说，“何苦陪在这里受冻。”“你在这里办公事，我一个人怎么睡得着？”听得这话，裘丰言的骨头奇轻，伸手到她的脸上，将她那象泻粉似的皮肉轻轻拧了一把，然后提起笔来，埋头疾书。他的一笔小楷，又快又好，抄完不过五更时分，胖太太劝他先睡一会，裘丰言不肯，吃过一杯早酒，挡挡寒气，趁着酒兴，步行到了巡抚衙门，找着刘二，道明来意。
en: Moved by their appreciation, Qiu exerted himself unusually hard. Back home, he did not return to bed. Fortunately, the effects of the foreign liquor wore off readily. After washing his face and drinking two cups of strong tea, he felt clear-headed. He trimmed the lamp, rubbed the ink, and resolved to copy the memorandum properly so that he could take it to the governor's yamen first thing in the morning. His activity disturbed his stout wife's sleep. “You wretch!” she scolded affectionately from behind the bed curtains. “In the middle of the night, in weather this cold, why don't you drag yourself to bed? What are you up to?” “Go back to sleep. I have official business.” This was news indeed. Qiu spent his days being busy about nothing and had never put brush to paper on official work. To claim it at such an hour was extraordinary. “Tell that to the ghosts! What official business? You're playing some foolish trick for amusement again. New Year's nearly here. Think about that! How are you going to get through New Year's Eve?” “It's precisely to get through it that I'm working myself to death. Stop bothering me. Once I finish, I still have to go to the governor's yamen.” That could hardly be a prank. Half disbelieving, and unwilling to let her old companion work himself to death alone, she rose and came over. Seeing “Memorandum” on the cover of the plain folded paper, she finally believed him. “Go to bed,” he said, rubbing his hands. “Why stand here freezing with me?” “How could I sleep alone while you're doing official work?” Her words made him feel delightfully light. He reached out and gently pinched her cheek, soft as starch paste, then took up his brush and wrote rapidly with his head bent. His small regular script was both swift and elegant. He finished by the fifth watch. His wife urged him to sleep a little, but he refused. After an early cup of liquor to keep out the cold, he walked, fortified by it, to the governor's yamen, found Liu Er, and explained his errand.

zh: 由于裘丰言为人和气，所以人缘极好，刘二跟他是开玩笑惯了的，把“裘老爷”叫成：“舅老爷！”他笑着说道，“已经冬天了，‘秋风’早就过去了，你这两个说帖没得用！”“难道上说帖就是想打秋风？”裘丰言答道：“今年还没有找过你的麻烦，这件事无论如何要帮我的忙。”“怎么帮法？”“马上送到抚台手里，不但送到，还要请他老人家马上就看。”“有这么紧要？”刘二倒怀疑了，“什么事，你先跟我说一说。”裘丰言已听嵇鹤龄和胡雪岩谈过，知道刘二对龚家父子亦颇不满，心想，这件事不必瞒他，便招一招手把他拉到僻处，悄悄说道：“我有个户头要推销洋枪，这件事成功了，回扣当然有你一份。”“推销洋枪！”刘二细想一想，从裘丰言跟胡雪岩的关系上去猜测，就知道了是怎么回事？便毫不迟疑地答道：“我有数了。倘有信息送哪里？”这句话把裘丰言问住了，他得先想一想，是什么“信息”？如果是黄抚台的约见，则嵇鹤龄已经说过，不会有这样的情形。看起来，这个推断还是不确，得要预备一下。“你是说抚台会找我？”裘丰言想了想答道，“你寻我不易，这样吧，我下午再来一趟。”“也好！如果有信息，而我又不在，必定留下信，否则就是没有消息，你请回好了。”这样约定以后，裘丰言方始回家补觉，一睡睡到午后两点才醒，只见胖太太递给他一封信，是胡雪岩写来的，约他下午三点在阜康钱庄见面。原来说好了，晚上仍旧在嵇家相会，如今提前约晤，必有缘故。裘丰言不敢怠慢，匆匆漱洗，出门赴约。
en: Qiu's amiability made him well liked. Liu Er was accustomed to joking with him, punning on “Master Qiu” by calling him “Uncle.” “It's winter already,” he laughed. “The autumn wind has long passed. These two memoranda of yours won't do any good!” “Does submitting a memorandum always mean coming to cadge money? I haven't troubled you once this year. You must help me this time.” “How?” “Put it into the governor's hands at once—and ask him to read it at once too.” “Is it that urgent?” Liu was doubtful. “Tell me what it's about first.” From Ji and Hu, Qiu knew that Liu resented the Gongs. There was no need to conceal this from him. He beckoned him aside and whispered, “I have a client who wants to sell foreign guns. If it succeeds, there'll naturally be a share of the commission for you.” “Foreign guns!” Thinking it over and taking Qiu's connection with Hu into account, Liu understood. He answered without hesitation, “I see. Where shall I send word if there's news?” That stumped Qiu. What sort of news? If it meant a summons from Governor Huang, Ji had said none would come. Perhaps the prediction was uncertain after all, and he ought to prepare. “You mean the governor might send for me?” he asked after a moment. “I'm hard to find. I'll come again this afternoon.” “Very well. If there's news and I'm out, I'll leave a message. If there's none, you can go home.” With that settled, Qiu returned to make up his lost sleep. He did not wake until two in the afternoon, when his wife handed him a letter from Hu asking him to come to Fukang at three. They had agreed to meet at Ji's that evening. There must be a reason for the earlier appointment. Qiu hurriedly washed, rinsed his mouth, and went out.

zh: 一到阜康钱庄，头一个就遇见陈世龙，彼此是熟识的，寒暄了几句，去见胡雪岩，只见他神采焕发，喜气洋洋，不由得诧异：“咦！你今天象个新郎官！”胡雪岩笑一笑，不理他的话，只问：“那东西递上去了？”“昨天晚上回去……”他倒也不是“丑表功”，只要说明替好朋友办事的诚意，所以把整个经过情形讲了一遍。“好极！事缓则圆。回头你就再辛苦一趟，看看有什么信息，打听过了，晚上我们在嵇家喝酒。”“好，好，我这就去。”裘丰言又问，“不过有件事我不明白，你特为约我此刻见面，就是问这句话？”“是的！我的意思，怕你说帖还不曾送出去，就摆一摆，等我到了上海，把那个普鲁士人的底细摸清楚了再说。既然已送了出去，那也很好。”这一说裘丰言更为困惑，“怎么，一下子想到要去上海？”他问：“哪天动身？”“日子还没有定，总在这两天。喔，”胡雪岩想起一件事，从口袋里取出一个红封袋，塞到裘丰言手里，笑着说道，“赶快回去跟你胖太太交帐，好让她早早筹划打年货！”裘丰言抽开封套看，是一张四百两银子的银票，心里愧感交集，眼圈有些发红。胡雪岩不肯让他说出什么来，推着他说：“请吧，请吧，我不留你了，回头嵇家见。”
en: The first person he met at Fukang was Chen Shilong, an old acquaintance. After a few words of greeting, he went to Hu and found him looking radiant and delighted. “Well!” Qiu exclaimed. “You look like a bridegroom today!” Hu smiled, ignored the remark, and asked only, “Has that thing been submitted?” “When I got home last night...” Qiu described the whole business, with no intention of boasting, simply to show how sincerely he had worked for his friends. “Excellent! Matters settle better when we take our time. Trouble yourself to go once more and see whether there's news. After that, we'll drink at Ji's this evening.” “Certainly. I'll go now. But there's something I don't understand. Did you specially ask me here now just to ask that?” “Yes. If you hadn't sent it in, I meant to hold it back until I'd been to Shanghai and learned more about that Prussian. Since it's already gone, that's fine too.” Qiu was more puzzled. “Why this sudden thought of Shanghai? When are you leaving?” “No date is fixed, but within the next day or two. Oh!” Remembering something, Hu took a red envelope from his pocket and pushed it into Qiu's hand. “Hurry home and report to your stout wife, so she can start buying for the New Year.” Qiu opened it and found a banknote for four hundred taels. Gratitude mingled with a sense of unworthiness, and his eyes reddened. Hu would not let him say anything. Gently urging him away, he said, “Off you go! I won't keep you. See you at Ji's later.”

zh: 陈世龙的不速而至，在胡雪岩颇感意外，但说穿了就不希奇，是刘不才“抓差”。到庞家的交涉，还算顺利，主要的还是靠胡雪岩自己，由于他那两封信，王有龄对庞二自然另眼相看。嘱咐刑名老夫子替他们调解争产的纠纷。原告是庞二的一个远房叔叔，看见知府出面调停，知道这场这司打下去得不到便宜，那时“敬酒不吃吃罚酒”，未免不智，所以愿意接受调解。庞二早就有过表示。花几个钱不在乎，能够不打官司不上堂，心里就安逸了。因此，看了胡雪岩的信，听了刘不才的叙述，一口答应帮忙。只是年近岁逼，人又在南浔，一下子要凑一大笔现银出来，倒也有些吃力。“我来想办法！一定可以想得出。你就不必管了，先玩一玩再说。”果然是胡雪岩预先猜到的情形出现了，刘不才心想，如果辞谢，必惹庞二不快，说不定好事就会变卦，但坐下来先赌一场，又耽误了胡雪岩的正事。灵机一动，想到个两全其美的办法。“庞二哥，我受人之托，要忠人之事，本来应该赶回去，不过你留我陪着你玩，我也实在舍不得走。要玩玩个痛快，不要叫我牵肠挂肚。这样，”他略作沉吟之态，然后用那种事事不无可疑，非如此办不可的语气说：“庞二哥，你把雪岩托你的事筹划好，我到湖州找个人回去送信！”“好！”庞二很爽快地答应，“你坐一下，我到帐房里去问一问看。”他一走，刘不才也不愿白耽误工夫，立刻就写了一封信，请庞家派个人到湖州，把陈世龙找来待命。
en: Chen's unexpected arrival had surprised Hu, but the explanation was simple: Liu Bucai had pressed him into service. Negotiations at the Pang household had gone fairly smoothly, largely because of Hu's own earlier efforts. His two letters had naturally led Wang Youling to treat Pang with special consideration and instruct his legal secretary to mediate the inheritance dispute. The plaintiff, a distant uncle of Pang's, saw that with the prefect intervening, continuing the lawsuit would bring him no advantage. It would be foolish to reject a cup offered courteously only to drink one imposed as punishment, so he accepted mediation. Pang had already said that he did not mind spending a little, provided he could avoid litigation and appearing in court. That would put his mind at rest. After reading Hu's letter and hearing Liu's explanation, he agreed at once to help. But with the year's end so close, and himself in Nanxun, assembling a large sum in cash immediately was difficult. “I'll find a way. I certainly will! Don't trouble yourself. Let's enjoy a game first.” Exactly as Hu had predicted. Liu thought that refusal would offend Pang and might undo the good result. Yet sitting down to gamble would delay Hu's business. Then he hit upon a way to satisfy both. “Brother Pang, I've been entrusted with something and must see it through. I ought to hurry back. But since you want me to stay and play, I'm reluctant to leave too. Let me enjoy it properly, without something weighing on my mind. How about this...” He paused as though considering, then spoke as though nothing could be taken on trust and this was the only arrangement that would do. “Settle what Xueyan asked you to do, and I'll get someone from Huzhou to take the news back!” “Good!” Pang agreed readily. “Sit here. I'll ask in the counting house.” Liu would not waste time while he was away. He wrote at once and asked the Pang household to send someone to Huzhou for Chen Shilong, who was to come and await instructions.

zh: “家里倒有点现银，过年要留着做赌本，也防着穷朋友穷亲戚来告贷，不能给老胡。”庞二说道，“我在上海有好几十万帐好收，划出二十五万给老胡，不过要他自己去收，有两笔帐或许收不到，看他自己的本事。”“好的，好的！”刘不才觉得有此结果，大可满足、“你帮雪岩这么一个大忙，我代表他谢谢。不过，这笔款子，怎么算法，你是要货色，还是怎么样？请吩咐了，我好通知雪岩照办。”“要什么货色？算我借给老胡的，等他把那票丝脱手了还我。”“是！那么，利息呢？”“免息！”“这不好意思吧……”刘不才迟疑着。“老刘！”庞二放低了声音，“我跟你投缘，说老实话吧，其中有两笔帐，大概七八万银子上下，不大好收。听好老胡跟松漕帮的尤老五，交情很够，这两笔帐托尤老五去收，虽不能十足回笼，七成帐是有的。能够这样，我已经承情不尽，尤老五那里，我自然另有谢意，这都等我跟老胡见了面再谈。”
en: “There is some silver in the house,” Pang said, “but I must keep it for New Year gambling and for poor friends and relations who come to borrow. I can't give that to Old Hu. I have several hundred thousand owing to me in Shanghai. I'll assign him two hundred and fifty thousand, but he'll have to collect it himself. Two debts may prove uncollectable. That will depend on his ability.” “Excellent!” Liu was thoroughly satisfied. “On his behalf, thank you for such a great favour. But how is this money to be treated? Do you want goods for it, or something else? Tell me so that I can notify Xueyan.” “What goods? It's a loan. He can repay me when he's sold that consignment of silk.” “Yes. And the interest?” “None!” “Surely that's too much to ask...” Liu hesitated. Pang lowered his voice. “Old Liu, we get on well, so I'll speak frankly. Two of those debts, amounting to perhaps seventy or eighty thousand, will be hard to collect. I hear Old Hu is very close to You Laowu of the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood. If he asks You to collect them, we should recover seventy per cent, even if we can't get it all. I'd be deeply grateful for that. I'll thank You separately, of course. I'll discuss it all with Hu when we meet.”
